purpose: Repair native Amber-to-OpenMM atom-identity mapping causing 6DBK ligand preparation failure, preserving the forcefield and validation limits. Validate software equivalence and downstream state continuity only; no physical-state accuracy, general forcefield accuracy, binding, uncertainty or MD convergence claim.

reproducibility.loaded_source_scope: The full preparation worker began before the final constructor-consistency guard was added. Final tests, retained matrix, and both prepared/solvated PDB reloads exercised current source. Source hashes recorded by the reload check do not certify which module bytes were loaded by the earlier worker; numerical mapping logic was unchanged by that guard.

data.representation_policy: Preserve native Amber atom ordering, connectivity, charges, bond/angle/dihedral parameters, exclusions and 1-4 scaling. Do not mutate ligand/protein chemistry, change protonation, replace torsions approximately, loosen tolerances, or discard molecules to pass conversion. Retain original failed artifacts. Bound heavy coordinates are evidence of source pose, not energetic relaxation.

validation.status: Scoped software checks passed; physical accuracy and convergence remain unvalidated.
validation.baseline: Graph-only XML matching permuted eight symmetric atoms and changed four improper terms; the adapter preserves the explicit native mapping.
validation.production_continuity: Prepared and explicitly solvated 6DBK datasets reloaded from PDB and saved bundle factory; all 729 native ligand parameter terms match in each assembled system at six-decimal canonicalization. Separate energy/force checks retain production limits.
validation.negative_controls: Tests reject changed torsion strength, renamed/duplicated/missing atoms, wrong elements, changed connectivity/external bonds, absent identity bindings, inconsistent indices and malformed provenance; explicit template selection cannot bypass identity.
validation.scope_refinement: Diagnosis showed graph-template automorphism, not native-to-XML torsion conversion, was defective. No torsion converter was rewritten. Real ligand/cofactor fixtures, exact native term comparison and 27 identity-specific regressions replaced speculative synthetic converter expansion; unequal duplicate native improper support is unchanged.
limits: No new trajectory or MD convergence assessment.
Representative finite coverage does not imply exhaustive chemistry support.
No new covalent-ligand, unsupported metal or unnatural-residue models.
Private OpenMM matching hooks require these integration regressions after version changes.

comparison.notes: Deterministic software equivalence check with predefined absolute error limits; no hypothesis testing, predictive ML benchmark, independent replica convergence claim or chemical accuracy comparison.
comparison.uncertainty_note: Statistical and biophysical uncertainty intervals are not supplied. Fixed-pose numerical errors are fully reported and are not relabeled as uncertainty intervals. The generic PatAgent uncertainty gate remains failed, limiting scientific accuracy/prediction claims; this change is a tested atom-mapping software correction.

review_identity: Independent language-model evidence/code review. This reviewer wrote the audit and matrix runner; separate agents implemented production code, regression tests and full-complex checks. PatAgent is an automated public-writing-inspired checklist, not expert endorsement.
